title: Adding PLDM dissector
description:
This commit implemements PLDM dissector
for base specification. The implementation
for the protocol is done following DMTF
guideline documentation -
https://www.dmtf.org/sites/default/files/standards/documents/DSP0240_1.1.0.pdf

Testing : For verification of dissector
a pcap file collected during poweron.

Test Pcap : test_pcap/mctp-binding.pcap

Signed-off-by: Riya Dixit <riyadixitagra@gmail.com>

@@ -0,0 +1,24 @@
+#include "config.h"
+#include <epan/packet.h>
+
+#include <stdint.h>
+#ifndef PACKET_PLDM_H
+#define PACKET_PLDM_H
+
+enum PLDMType {
+	PLDM_DISCOVERY,
+	PLDM_SMBIOS,
+	PLDM_PLATFORM,
+	PLDM_BIOS,
+	PLDM_FRU,
+	PLDM_FIRMWARE_UPDATE,
+	PLDM_REDFISH,
+	PLDM_OEM=63
+};
+
+struct packet_data {
+    guint8 direction;
+    guint8 instance_id;
+};
+
+#endif
